summary_md: **ai\_binbin ([@ai_binbin](https://x.com/ai_binbin/status/2116433235366330419))** rounds up community shells built on the **OpenCode** and **Pi** agent cores, including oh-my-openagent, Kilo Code, OpenWork, MiMo-Code, OpenChamber, pi-web, PI-Desktop, Hugging Face's tau, pi_agent_rust, gentle-shell and pi-gui ([e.g. huggingface/tau](https://github.com/huggingface/tau), [openchamber](https://github.com/openchamber/openchamber)).
